name: distcc
listed_description: Distributed compiler: ships compile jobs to build servers on the network; CMake uses it via the compiler launcher variable.
claim_text: Pump mode with a cpp host suffix further increases compilation speed by also distributing preprocessing to the servers.
book_benchmark: No measurement. Book only describes setup (distccd daemon, DISTCC_HOSTS with cpp and lzo suffixes) and warns that a slow network can cancel the gain.
found_in: book: CMake Best Practices (2024), ch. 14, section Optimizing build performance, distributed builds with distcc

name: icecream (icecc)
listed_description: Distributed compiler wrapper with central scheduler, named only in passing as an alternative to distcc that can be chained after ccache via CCACHE_PREFIX.
found_in: book: CMake Best Practices (2024), ch. 14, section Using a compiler cache (ccache) to speed up rebuilds, CCACHE_PREFIX bullet
